tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

weaknesses.detail: Won 2 of 10 tackles (20%) - diving in; each miss leaves a runner free
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

push.title: L 2-3 vs NorthStar | You: 7.9
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.9 is a good day. Not a great one yet, but good is the step before great.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at NorthStar's goal. Their defense never got a moment of peace.
+ Tackles attempted 10, up from your usual 6. Gold star, no notes.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Keep that in your back pocket.
+ Team-high 1 key passes. That doesn't happen by accident.

THE BAD
- 2 of 5 shots on target. Here's the play: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. Bread and butter.
- 63% passing (17 of 27, down from your usual 80%). For next time: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
- Won 2 of 10 tackles. Here's the trick: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.
- You and buddskees were both flagged for forcing passes. Fix it as a pair: give each other short options.
- Key passes 1, down from your usual 2. One honest look at that and we move forward.

THE UGLY
! This was the relegation match we lost: Relegation match L 2-3 vs NorthStar. Down to Division 4. I'm not gonna pretty that up for you.

Session plan: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

Hey PhogsToffees, hold onto this one: The scoreboard counts goals; I count growth.

Let's turn the page. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-3 vs NorthStar | You: 7.5
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.5 against NorthStar. Little rusty. Nothing a few good reps can't polish.

THE GOOD
+ Won 3 of 4 tackles. Sharp, clean, decisive. That's how it's done.
+ 1 assist. You set the table and let everybody else eat.
+ That's a partnership I'd build a team around: you and PhogsToffees.
+ 4th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's the stuff I want framed.
+ Fewest giveaways on the team (7). Keep that in your back pocket.

THE BAD
- 71% passing (15 of 21, down from your usual 82%). Coach's tip: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back. Habits beat highlights.
- PhogsToffees and you both slipped on forcing passes. Catch each other: give each other short options.
- 0.4 below your norm. Chin up, eyes forward.
- Shots 0, down from your usual 2. Game plan: When you've got a clear look inside the box, pull the trigger. Hesitation lets defenders recover.

THE UGLY
! This was the relegation match we lost: Relegation match L 2-3 vs NorthStar. Down to Division 4. That's not who we are, and it can't be who we become.

Drill: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

buddskees, something I want you to sleep on: A bad touch is just a good touch that got lost.

Ups and downs make a roller coaster, and roller coasters are fun. - Coach Lasso
